text: Sources agree that the Murdoch family announced the settlement of the succession dispute over the Murdoch Family Trust on 2025-09-08, in a deal reported at $3.3 billion, with each of the three departing siblings, Prudence, Elisabeth and James Murdoch, reported to receive $1.1 billion, the new Lachlan-controlled trust expected to hold about 33.1% of News Corp's Class B voting stock, the family trust giving eight votes over the boards of News Corp and Fox News of which Rupert Murdoch controlled four, and the probate trial beginning on 2024-09-16 at the Washoe County Courthouse in Reno, Nevada. They disagree on the date Nevada probate commissioner Edmund Gorman Jr. ruled against Rupert and Lachlan Murdoch's attempt to amend the family trust, with sources variously saying 2024-12-07, 2024-12-09, or simply December 2024. No primary source in this run settles the disputed points.
